_about: Settings for tools/optimize-pdfs.js. Reasoning for each value: CLAUDE.md, 'PDF optimizer'. Bump settingsVersion whenever a value that changes the output changes, so files are re-derived from _originals/.
_viewerMaxCanvasPixels: Mirror of MAX_CANVAS_PIXELS in engine/pdf-view.js: one canvas per page, so on an A0 sheet the viewer never shows more than ~74 dpi, at any zoom.
_headroom: Target image resolution = headroom x the most the viewer can show for that page size (A0 ~74 dpi, A1 ~104, A3 ~210 at 1.0). 1.0 chosen after a side-by-side preview (October 2026). If MAX_CANVAS_PIXELS in pdf-view.js is raised, raise this too and rerun with --force (re-derives from _originals/).
_resampleAbove: Only images more than this factor over the target are resampled (avoids re-encoding for a few percent).
_minResample: Images smaller than this are never resampled: they carry almost no bytes, and CAD exports often build one picture (e.g. a title-block logo) from many thin image strips, which visibly seam when each strip is resampled on its own.
_maxMaskTransparentPercent: An image whose soft mask is fully transparent over more than this share is a shaped overlay (AutoCAD exports translucent fills and outlines that way: line art in a picture), not a render; it is never resampled. Renders in these files have no fully transparent pixels at all.
_minImagePsnrDb: Each resampled image vs a high-quality downscale of its original.
_render: Page render check through Ghostscript (only when one is found): whole page at the viewer's 1x, and the worst of 16 tiles at the viewer's maximum zoom.
_minSavingPercent: A file is only replaced when it gets at least this much smaller.
_sizes: generate-manifest.js: warn for PDFs over warnUnoptimizedMB that aren't in the ledger; soft note for optimized PDFs still over noteOptimizedMB.
_sample: Pages checked by rendering: first, last, the N with the most resampled image area, and M seeded-random ones.
